description: This file defines the Java class RetrieveConfigResponse, which represents a response message for retrieving configuration data within the Ditto signals command framework. It encapsulates a JSON configuration object, includes methods for creation from JSON, and overrides object methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: RetrieveConfigResponse
classes.description: A Java class representing a response containing a configuration payload, extending CommonCommandResponse, with methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and standard overrides.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new RetrieveConfigResponse with the provided JSON config and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveConfigResponse instance from a JSON object and headers, extracting the config field.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the config JSON value to a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of RetrieveConfigResponse with the same config but updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, comparing the config field.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on superclass hash and the config field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including class name, superclass string, and config.
